title: UltrafastEngine system file (.ufs)
description: An optical system as a chain of elements (docs/reference/system-file.md). SI units: the key suffix names the unit (lengthM: metres).

version.description: Format version (older versions are migrated on load).

source.description: Provenance of the file (written by exporters, e.g. the zemax plugin); free-form

sampling.description: Wavelengths of all per-wavelength arrays in the file

environment.description: Air of the laboratory and the index reference of quoted data

materials.description: Materials defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/materials.md)

coatings.description: Coatings defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/coatings.md)

substrates.description: Mirror substrates defined in this file, by name: material, thicknessM, backCoating / backReflectance, wedgeDeg (docs/reference/coatings.md#substrate-echoes)

inputBeam.description: Default beam for nonlinear elements without one A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, sampled).

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema (editor support).

wavelengthsM.description: Wavelengths [m]

indexReference.description: Quoted data are relative to air (OpticStudio) or vacuum Default: vacuum (air for zemax exports).

air.description: Air: temperatureC, pressurePa, humidity, co2ppm, or an index model with kind

kind.description: An index model kind instead (e.g. "ciddor", or "hitran" with the hitran plugin)

applyToGaps.description: Use this air (humidity, temperature, pressure, gas lines) as the "Air" of every gap; a gap's own "air" overrides it. Off by default: existing results do not change Default: false.

target.description: material:NAME, element:ID (trailing * wildcard), element:*, type:TYPE or global

property.description: Property to change (lengthM, n2, index, beam, coating, timeResponse, filter, enabled, ...)

value.description: New value (numbers may carry a unit string: "2.2E-20 m^2/W")

model.description: New model (an object with kind, an expression, or "@callback")

mode.description: replace, or add (time responses and filters) Default: replace.

obj.betweenPasses.description: Losses and dispersion between passes / per round trip.

delayS.description: Pulsed pump: time before the seed [s]

points.description: Radial samples (cartesian: nx = ny if omitted) Default: 64.

radiusM.description: Radial grid extent [m] Default: extentFactor x expected radius.

extentFactor.description: Grid extent / expected beam radius Default: 3.5.

paraxial.description: Paraxial diffraction operator instead of the exact one Default: false.

transport.description: How a profile from before is brought in Default: auto.

initialProfile.description: The field at the first spatial element

polarization.description: Jones (vector) fields on the grid: auto = when the beam carries a y component Default: auto.

equation.description: Nonlinear coupling: paraxial envelope, or UPPE (n omega / c k_z per plane wave) Default: envelope.

spectralSamples.description: Frequencies at which the transverse profile is stored and (linear elements) propagated; fewer is faster for narrowband pulses Default: 48.

absorbingBoundary.description: Linear elements: absorb light leaving the grid instead of reflecting / wrapping it -- true (outer 15 %) or {widthFraction}; the absorbed energy is booked as 'grid boundary' (docs/reference/transverse.md#diffraction-and-apertures) Default: false.

kind.description: Shape: Gaussian, super-Gaussian (order), flatTop (super-Gaussian of order 10), tophat (hard edge, uniform), Hermite-Gauss (modeX, modeY), Laguerre-Gauss (modeP, modeL), Bessel-Gauss (coneAngleRad), Airy (radiusM = scale, truncation), measured (file) Default: gaussian.

modeL.description: laguerreGauss: azimuthal index l (helical phase, cartesian grids) Default: 0.

coneAngleRad.description: besselGauss: cone angle of the plane waves, k_r = k sin(angle) [rad]

truncation.description: airy: the exponential truncation a in Ai(x / x0) exp(a x / x0) Default: 0.1.

file.description: measured: NPZ with x_m, y_m (or r_m), fluence or amplitude, and optionally phase_rad; relative to the file that names it

background.description: measured: a number subtracted from the fluence, or "auto" (the median of the map's edge)

pixelSizeM.description: measured: pixel size of a PNG image [m]

threshold.description: measured: fluence below this fraction of the peak is set to zero Default: 0.

center.description: measured: move the fluence centroid to the axis Default: false.

geometry.description: round: a function of r (elliptical with radiusXM != radiusYM); square: separable in x and y (rectangular, cartesian grids) Default: round.

radiusM.description: 1/e^2 radius; tophat: edge radius or half-width (default: from the element's beam) [m]

ripple.description: Seed ripple (cartesian): {periodM, relativeAmplitude, angleDeg, phaseRad}: amplitude x (1 + a cos(2 pi (x cos t + y sin t) / period + phase)). The Bespalov-Talanov seed (docs/reference/transverse.md#small-scale-self-focusing)

noise.description: Seeded random noise (cartesian): {relativeAmplitudeRms, phaseRmsRad, correlationLengthM, seed, components}

element.amplifier.description: Multipass or regenerative amplifier around one gain medium (1-D). (docs/reference/gain.md#the-amplifier-element)

ghosts.description: Ghost replicas of the end faces: true / false or a ghosts object (components.md#ghost-reflections) Default: false.

roundTrips.description: Round trips (regenerative) or "auto" (eject at the maximum) Default: "auto".

passesPerRoundTrip.description: Crystal passes per round trip Default: 2.

medium.description: Yb:YAG, Ti:sapphire, Nd:YAG, a materials entry, or an object A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind".

pump.description: kind, powerW / energyJ, wavelengthM, radiusM, profile, order, passes, delayS

inversion.description: fraction or smallSignalGain (instead of / before a pump)

beam.description: Signal beam A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, sampled).

thermalLens.description: true / false or {rodRadiusM, heatFraction, apply, track, focalLengthM, passGapM, stress}: track (default true; amplifier: only when given) puts the thermal lens on the tracked Gaussian beam; passGapM is the free path between amplifier passes; focalLengthM is a measured thermal focal length used instead of the heat model; stress adds thermal birefringence (docs/reference/gain.md#thermal-lens)

spm.description: SPM of the host Default: true.

steadyState.description: true / false or {maxPulses, tolerance} Default: true.

dopingProfile.description: Position-dependent doping factor A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, superGaussian, table).

ase.description: Seed amplified spontaneous emission (1-D) Default: false.

enabled.description: false skips the element Default: true.

next.description: Branched systems: where the light goes. A target ("bs:1", {"id": "bs", "port": 1}, "end", "virtual"), or an object of targets by output port (docs/reference/branches.md)

inputs.description: Virtual input beams by input port: the keys of an aux beam, with phaseRad and coherentWith, or {"virtual": true} for an input left empty on purpose (docs/reference/branches.md)

loop.description: Branched systems: on the element where light enters a loop: kind ("ringDown", "steadyState"), maxRoundTrips, tolerance (docs/reference/branches.md)
